issue.title: test_init_help_lists_existing_subcommands expects old --project help formatting
issue.description: During unrelated link-follow module-splitting verification, just test-scoped escalated to the full suite and failed tests/main/test_init_onboarding_parser.py::test_init_help_lists_existing_subcommands. I reran the three full-suite failures in isolation on the same tree; the other two passed, but this node failed again with the same assertion: expected "-p NAME, --project NAME" in `sase init --help`, while argparse output shows `[-a | -M | -p NAME]` in usage and does not contain that combined option string. The local diff only touches src/sase/ace/tui/actions/link_follow*.py, so this is unrelated to the refactor.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed in the full pytest lane and then failed again in an isolated exact rerun on the same tree with the same assertion, while the two other full-lane failures passed in that rerun.
